claims.text: Pembrolizumab (Keytruda Qlex) + chemoradiation: locally advanced FIGO 2014 stage III–IVA
claims.quote: KEYTRUDA QLEX, in combination with chemoradiotherapy (CRT), is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with locally advanced cervical cancer involving the lower third of the vagina, with or without extension to pelvic sidewall, or hydronephrosis/non-functioning kidney, or spread to adjacent pelvic organs (FIGO 2014 Stage III-IVA).
